pattern: {p:Player} create[s] a token that's a copy of {o:Obj} , except {x:CopyExceptToken}
subject: player

examples.text: Whenever a creature with a hatch counter on it dies, you create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's a Spirit in addition to its other types.
Destroy target creature. Its controller creates a token that's a copy of that creature, except it isn't legendary.

counterExamples: Whenever a creature with a hatch counter on it dies, you create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's a Spirit.
Whenever a creature with a hatch counter on it dies, you create two tokens that are copies of that creature, except it's a Spirit in addition to its other types.

subject: none

examples.text: Whenever ~ attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of another target creature you control, except it isn't legendary and it has haste.
Whenever ~ attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of another target creature you control, except it's a Synth artifact creature in addition to its other types.

counterExamples: Whenever ~ attacks, create a token that's a copy of another target creature you control, except it isn't legendary and it has haste.
Whenever ~ attacks, create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of another target creature you control, except it isn't legendary and it has haste until end of turn.

pattern: {p:Player} copies {o:Obj} for each {f:Filter} that ( the spell | spell ) could target
subject: none

examples.text: Whenever a player casts an instant spell that targets only a single Goblin, that player copies that spell for each Goblin you control that the spell could target. Each copy targets a different one of those Goblins.

Whenever a player casts a sorcery spell that targets only a single Golem, that player copies that spell for each artifact they control that the spell could target. Each copy targets a different one of those artifacts.

counterExamples: Whenever a player casts an instant spell that targets only a single Goblin, that player copies that spell for each Goblin you control that the spell could target.

Whenever a player casts an instant spell that targets only a single Goblin, that player copies that spell for each Goblin you control that you could target. Each copy targets a different one of those Goblins.

pattern: for each of {t:Them} , create a token that's a copy of ( that creature | that permanent | that artifact )
subject: none

examples.text: Choose any number of target creatures you control. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of that creature.
Choose up to two target artifacts you control. For each of those artifacts, create a token that's a copy of that artifact.

counterExamples: Choose any number of target creatures you control. For each of them, create two tokens that are copies of that creature.
Choose any number of target creatures you control. For each of them, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it has haste until end of turn.
